en: A black‑and‑white postcard view of a narrow canal flanked by tall multi‑story buildings with many windows. Laundry hangs from some windows and balconies extend over the water. In the distance, a prominent neo‑Gothic church spire rises above the surrounding buildings. At the bottom margin, cursive text identifies the location as a canal (Fleet) near Stockelhörn and St. Nikolai Church in Hamburg.
